_note: Example only, with placeholder codes. The real file, config/online/completion_codes.json, is written at deploy time by tools/jatos_deploy.py from the codes the Prolific operations engine made when it drafted each study (data/prolific/completion_codes/<study_key>_w<wave>.json): into the study archive always, into this folder only with --write-local. It is git-ignored and never committed, because a participant who knew the finished code could skip the task. slots holds one set of four codes per Prolific study and wave, keyed '<study_key>_w<wave>' as the address names them (study_key and wave). There are no top-level codes (2026-10-12): the page reads only the slot of its own study_key and wave and does not start without it, so no run is sent back with another study's codes.
